recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless future CarePlan example maintenance reintroduces patient/person-oriented names or descriptions.
issue_request: FHIR-13877 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CarePlan technical correction asking that all CarePlan examples be renamed to be CarePlan-specific and match the content of each example, instead of using patient/person-oriented example descriptions.
initial_application: The request appears to have been applied in commit 32b35437cc8daef171fb42950801c6a39d6f918b, whose message explicitly includes '#13877 - update CarePlan example names'. That commit changed the CarePlan spreadsheet example descriptions from generic patient/person wording such as 'General Person Example', 'Patient 1 for linking', and 'Real-world patient example' to CarePlan/content-specific descriptions.
additional_context: CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini. The old spreadsheet source was later converted into source/careplan/list-CarePlan-examples.xml during the build-source rework, and the current List source retains CarePlan-specific titles, filenames, descriptions, and display labels. Community searches found no later contrary decision; the only Zulip hit was the original tracker bot announcement and Confluence had no issue references.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative CarePlan example list already satisfies the Jira request and no stale patient/person example naming remains in source/careplan.
